‘…Or maybe he’s actually a ghost.’
As I clamped my mouth shut to hide my panic, he spoke in a low voice.
“Darling, I don’t like people who break promises.”
“No, it’s not… that.”

The maid wanders the halls sobbing every night, the stablehand occasionally sheds scales from his body, and an eerie, unidentifiable hymn echoes from the castle’s chapel.

I rubbed my temples as I watched him.
My in-laws’ house was a den of all sorts of monsters.

After the guests had left, a man with wheat-colored skin knelt on the ground, hands bound, his chest covered with mottled marks.

while I’m just a nameless s*ave?’

….
